entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. I see your account pulled up here. Are we discussing the VeloBand Pulse that was delivered on December 24th?
Okay. To get the process started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it.
I see. Thanks for clarifying that. Since it's a matter of preference, let me review the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, so for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, because it's a wearable device that activates and links to a user's account, our return policy for preference-based returns is within 10 days of delivery. Since your device was delivered 18 days ago, we are outside of that return window for a refund.
Seriously? So I'm just out the money. Fantastic.
Not necessarily. While a direct return to VeloFit isn't an option at this point, you do have another great avenue. We run an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace for our community.
A marketplace. And what is that supposed to do?

It's a platform we host for VeloFit users to buy and sell certified gear with each other. Since you barely use the band, it's in perfect condition to be listed. It’s a very popular way for our customers to recoup their costs on items they don't need. The resale value on the Pulse is currently very high.
Fine. Whatever. Send me the link for it.
Of course. I am sending a direct link to get your listing started to the email we have on file. It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great experience with the marketplace. Have a good day.
